id: title:Piccirello:rate limit and harden share password checks

review.posthog_relevance: Adds account recovery security and abuse prevention for the account sharing feature, specifically preventing password guessing attacks and blocking non-standard HTTP requests.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates the implementation of account recovery throttling and request validation. P1.F2.H3 and P1.F2.H5 show the addition of a 429 status response for repeated failed password attempts and the enforcement of authentication checks to prevent bypassing the password gate. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in the reliability and security of account re-om
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the SharePassword model, SharePasswordVolumeThrottle, SharePasswordThrottle, or the SharePasswordViewSet retrieve implementation, so the full scope and behavior of the complete account sharing and recovery system cannot be assessed.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of SharePasswordVolumeThrottle and SharePasswordThrottle, nor the complete SharePassword model and its password hashing, nor the complete SharingViewerPageViewSet retrieve implementation. The chunk also does not include the complete SharePasswordVolumeThrottle and SharePasswordThrottle implementations, nor the complete SharePw

observations.behavior: Adds a 429 status and throttling response for repeated wrong password guesses, while allowing correct passwords to succeed regardless of the budget.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the request is not a POST and not JWT authenticated, then returns the unlock page. This prevents HEAD requests from bypassing the password gate.
